docs.title: DBA Knowledge Base
docs.text: Central index of all DBA docs. Nav on the left is auto-generated from folder structure — no manual maintenance needed.

docs.title: Sections
docs.text:
• oracle/ — RMAN, GoldenGate, archive shipping, OracleBridgeCmd/OracleRestoreCmd notes
  • postgres/ — streaming replication, WAL recovery, Ansible fleet automation, DR drills

To add a doc: drop a .md file in the right folder, commit, push. Nav and search update automatically on next build.

docs.title: PostgreSQL WAL Recovery Stalls During pg_basebackup Restores
Symptom
docs.text: Recovery stalls during DR drill restores on undersized Azure RHEL 8 VMs.

docs.title: Root causes identified
docs.text:
1. shared_buffers sized at production scale on undersized drill VMs
  2. Deadlock between startup process replaying multixact WAL records and checkpointer firing a restartpoint simultaneously

docs.title: Fix
docs.text:
• Right-size shared_buffers for drill VM specs
  • For the checkpointer deadlock: restore in single-user mode to eliminate the checkpointer entirely
